- c) / (r * r)
    normal /= np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(normal, axis=-1, keepdims=True), 1e-6)
    return np.where(valid, t, INF), normal


def intersect_cylinder(orig, dirs, center, size):
    c = np.asarray(center, np.float32)
    r, h = size[0], size[1]
    ox, oy, oz = orig - c
    dx, dy, dz = dirs[..., 0], dirs[..., 1], dirs[..., 2]
    a = dx * dx + dz * dz
    b = 2.0 * (ox * dx + oz * dz)
    cc = ox * ox + oz * oz - r * r
    disc = b * b - 4 * a * cc
    sqrt_disc = np.sqrt(np.maximum(disc, 0))
    denom = np.where(a < 1e-7, 1e-7, 2 * a)
    t0 = (-b - sqrt_disc) / denom
    t1 = (-b + sqrt_disc) / denom
    y0 = oy + t0 * dy
    y1 = oy + t1 * dy
    valid0 = (disc >= 0) & (t0 > 1e-4) & (np.abs(y0) <= h * 0.5)
    valid1 = (disc >= 0) & (t1 > 1e-4) & (np.abs(y1) <= h * 0.5)
    tside = np.where(valid0, t0, np.where(valid1, t1, INF))
    # caps
    tcap_top = (h * 0.5 - oy) / np.where(np.abs(dy) < 1e-7, 1e-7, dy)
    tcap_bot = (-h * 0.5 - oy) / np.where(np.abs(dy) < 1e-7, 1e-7, dy)
    x_top, z_top = ox + tcap_top * dx, oz + tcap_top * dz
    x_bot, z_bot = ox + tcap_bot * dx, oz + tcap_bot * dz
    valid_top = (tcap_top > 1e-4) & (x_top * x_top + z_top * z_top <= r * r)
    valid_bot = (tcap_bot > 1e-4) & (x_bot * x_bot + z_bot * z_bot <= r * r)
    ttop = np.where(valid_top, tcap_top, INF)
    tbot = np.where(valid_bot, tcap_bot, INF)
    t = np.minimum(tside, np.minimum(ttop, tbot))
    normal = np.zeros_like(dirs)
    finite = t < INF * 0.5
    side_mask = finite & (tside <= np.minimum(ttop, tbot))
    safe_t = np.where(finite, t, 0.0)
    hitx = ox + safe_t * dx
    hitz = oz + safe_t * dz
    norm = np.sqrt(hitx * hitx + hitz * hitz) + 1e-7
    normal[..., 0][side_mask] = hitx[side_mask] / norm[side_mask]
    normal[..., 2][side_mask] = hitz[side_mask] / norm[side_mask]
    top_mask = finite & (~side_mask) & (ttop <= tbot)
    bot_mask = finite & (~side_mask) & (~top_mask)
    normal[..., 1][top_mask] = 1.0
    normal[..., 1][bot_mask] = -1.0
    return t, normal


def room_surface(scene: SceneDef, dirs: np.ndarray):
    orig = np.asarray(scene.camera, np.float32)
    bmin = np.asarray(scene.room_bounds[0], np.float32)
    bmax = np.asarray(scene.room_bounds[1], np.float32)
    ts = []
    normals = []
    names = []
    for axis in range(3):
        for side in (0, 1):
            plane = bmin[axis] if side == 0 else bmax[axis]
            den = dirs[..., axis]
            t = (plane - orig[axis]) / np.where(np.abs(den) < 1e-7, 1e-7, den)
            valid = t > 1e-4
            hit = orig + dirs * t[..., None]
            for other in range(3):
                if other != axis:
                    valid &= (hit[..., other] >= bmin[other] - 1e-4) & (hit[..., other] <= bmax[other] + 1e-4)
            ts.append(np.where(valid, t, INF))
            n = np.zeros(3, np.float32)
            n[axis] = 1.0 if side == 0 else -1.0  # inward normal
            normals.append(n)
            names.append((axis, side))
    stack = np.stack(ts, axis=-1)
    idx = np.argmin(stack, axis=-1)
    t = np.take_along_axis(stack, idx[..., None], axis=-1)[..., 0]
    hit = orig + dirs * t[..., None]
    normal = np.zeros_like(dirs)
    base = np.zeros_like(dirs)
    for i, ((axis, side), n) in enumerate(zip(names, normals)):
        mask = idx == i
        normal[mask] = n
        if axis == 1 and side == 0:  # floor
            x, z = hit[..., 0], hit[..., 2]
            plank = (np.floor((x - bmin[0]) * 1.65) % 2) * 0.035
            grain = (np.sin(z * 5.3 + np.sin(x * 2.2)) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.045
            c = np.stack([0.48 + plank + grain, 0.31 + plank * 0.7 + grain * 0.45, 0.18 + grain * 0.25], axis=-1)
            base[mask] = c[mask]
        elif axis == 1 and side == 1:  # ceiling
            c = np.full_like(base, [0.88, 0.87, 0.82])
            base[mask] = c[mask]
        else:
            # subtle wall panels
            x, y, z = hit[..., 0], hit[..., 1], hit[..., 2]
            panel = (np.sin((x + z) * 3.5) > 0.985)
